scope: Orientation-corrected spectral comparisons on the released Figure 4 response and trace caches; unchanged checkpoint and response outcomes.
interpretation: Raw engagement adds predictive value beyond movement class and flexible path length. On the fixed image ensemble, total-power-normalized overlap adds a modest SSI increment beyond class, path and total dynamic power; the rate interval includes zero. Own-passband engagement outperforms shuffled and population-average passbands for SSI, conditional on the fitted model and finite-window estimator; the rate controls do not distinguish an own-passband benefit, and cross-scene generalization is not established.
